algebra: Epre = narrow[(1-f)*baseline + f*Dsupport + f*.74*Dtissue]; H is the exact linear upper/axillary biharmonic extension. ActualEcore = baseline + H(narrow[(1-f)*baseline+f*Dsupport]-baseline); actualEtissue = H(narrow-vector[f*.74*Dtissue]).
corefit_provenance: Dsupport front/back/width tables were native-section-informed estimates and include sternum/front-center values inherited from e9 in breast-height range. This audit does not assert that those center-front values exclude prior breast mass. Upper extension also retains baseline contributions by construction.

normal_offset_audit.definition: Dot(savedE evaluated point - actual no-Dsoft evaluated point, outward area-weighted no-Dsoft vertex normal); polygon loop correspondence checked, quad diagonals may differ.

actual_visual_findings: No-Dsoft renders retain a broad lower-thorax forward bulge and shallow under-bust-like rim. Surface continuity and positive explicit offsets cannot alone establish anatomically valid cage/core. Baseline blend residual is small; support fit itself requires separate review.
